about.title: Lawndale Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Lawndale sits at a busy crossroads of Los Angeles County traffic, with Hawthorne Boulevard, Rosecrans Avenue, Inglewood Avenue, and the I-405 all funneling vehicles through the city every day. Public records show 125 injury collisions and 167 injured people in the most recent final year, with Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. showing the heaviest reported activity. Whether your crash happened at a signal on Hawthorne, merging onto the 405, or crossing Rosecrans, the aftermath usually means medical appointments, missed work, and calls from an insurance adjuster who wants a statement. LawProactive doesn't practice law or charge you anything; we simply connect you with an independent personal injury attorney in the network who can review what happened and explain your options. Getting matched costs nothing, and there's no obligation to move forward if you'd rather not.

whyChoose.title: Why This Matters for Your Claim

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but claims against a government entity (like a public road defect) can require notice in as little as six months. Waiting too long to talk to someone can quietly close doors you didn't know were open.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cut Both Ways
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you're partly blamed for the crash, though your share of fault reduces the amount. An attorney can help make sure fault isn't overstated against you before it's locked in.

items.title: No Cap Doesn't Mean No Fight
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering, but insurers still push back hard on these numbers. Avoiding a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer and preserving evidence early can matter more than people expect.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement to the other insurer before speaking with an attorney. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my accident happened on Hawthorne Boulevard or near the 405 on-ramp?
items.answer: Those are among Lawndale's higher-traffic corridors, and crash evidence like traffic camera footage, skid marks, or debris can disappear quickly. Getting connected with an attorney soon after the crash can help preserve that evidence while it's still available. This applies whether the collision happened at an intersection or during a freeway merge.

items.question: How much does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent attorney in our network, and any attorney you work with typically handles injury cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover money. There's no obligation to hire anyone after being matched.
